sentences.text: Heard Sri Vinod Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ravi Srivastava, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the records.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 536 of 2024, under Sections 376-D, 392, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Maholi, District Sitapur.

2. Initially Sushila Tiwari W/o co-accused Lalu Tiwari (deponent of the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application) had lodged F.I.R. No.314 of 2024 against one Soni W/o Ritesh, Ritesh S/o Chandra Bhan and two other persons in furtherance of an application under Section 175 (3)
BNSS alleging commission of offences under Sections 127(2), 74, 352, 351 and 309 (4) B.N.S.
alleging molestation and snatching away a gold chain.

3. On 25.10.2024, Sonu Devi W/o Ashish (informant of F.I.R. No.304/2024) has lodged the present Vijay Pal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66394624/
1 F.I.R. on the basis of an application under Section 173 (4) BNSS against, the applicant, Lalu Tiwari and two unknown persons alleging that while she was waiting for some vehicle at about 10.00 a.m.
on 30.06.2024 for going to Maigalganj, the accused persons forcibly dragged her into a four wheeler vehicle, took her to a jungle and raped her.

sentences.text: She further alleged that the accused persons had snatched away a gold chain and ear rings.

4. In the statement of the informant recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. she reiterated the F.I.R.
version.
5. In the medico legal examination report no mark of injury or sign of use of force has been reported.
The radiological examination report of the informant mentions her age to be about 20 years.

6. In the statement of the informant recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she stated that she is aged 22 years and she reiterated the F.I.R. version.
7.

In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. The learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that there is an old animosity between the parties and a previous F.I.R. was lodged against the informant of the present case; the allegation of gang rape is not supported by the findings of medico legal examination report; that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 15.01.2025 and the investigation already stands concluded and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
10.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
